Collegium Musicum Iuvenale Ochsenfurt

Benefit Drum Workshop with André Mabiala and Bénédicte Ndota

February 21 and March 7, 2026 · CMI Ochsenfurt

On February 21 and March 7, 2026, two guests from the Congo visited CMI together with singers from Liederkranz, FAINO, and the Veeh harp group Querbeet. CMI has maintained a close collaboration with André Mabiala, chairman of Mbonda Lokito Kongo/Kinshasa Kinderhilfe e.V., since 2010. He has a remarkable gift for engaging all age groups through his drum workshops. Since the end of last year, Bénédicte Ndota has been staying in Germany to learn German, become familiar with European musical culture, and then begin an internship. She delighted the audience with her expressive voice. As she is living entirely on private donations until her internship begins in September, participants were able to contribute directly to her support.

Bénédicte Ndota will also be heard in the two concerts on May 1 and 2.
